crossrefs.text: For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.”
Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.
And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.”
No longer will you be called Forsaken, nor your land named Desolate; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be His bride.
The well-fed hire themselves out for food, but the starving hunger no more. The barren woman gives birth to seven, but she who has many sons pines away.

notes.title: Hagar and Sarah as two covenants

crossrefs.text: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
For Godʼs gifts and His call are irrevocable.
Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.
And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
I and the Father are one.”
The One who vindicates Me is near. Who will dare to contend with Me? Let us confront each other! Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me!
Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
“I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”

notes.title: All will be taught by God
